messages:
maria: Starting preflight for eu-west-3 private edge cluster for AcmeCorp. Air-gapped images will be seeded over shipping HDDs tomorrow. Need final checklist and a flag for GPU driver pinning. rolling window Fri 02:00-05:00 UTC. cc @raj @kevin

raj: quick checklist: IPAM assigned? BGP neighbors configured? customer VPN handshake done?

kevin: IPAM yes (10.240.0.0/16). BGP pending — need customer ASNs and prefixes. I've raised ticket NET-472.

olivia: image seeding: ensure signed tarballs, sha256 in seed manifest, and mirroring via local registry. I'll push manifest tonight.

maria: good. add items: KMS key provisioning (customer HSM), NTP sources locked to customer NTP, fw rules for registry+artifact ports (443, 5000), and apt/yum mirror config.

raj: GPU notes: drivers we pin to 525.85.05, CUDA 12.1; customer requested MIG disable for this workload. Also confirm DC has NVIDIA firmware 24.03.

kevin: capacity: target initial pool = 8x A100-80GB (shared), expect 1200 tokens/sec @p50 48ms, cost run estimate attached to ticket.

olivia: airgap seed process snippet:
```
# on seed host
s3fs mount /mnt/seed
tar xzf acme-images-2026-03-01.tar.gz -C /var/lib/registry
sha256sum -c manifest.sha256
registry-cli load --insecure --local /var/lib/registry
```

maria: networking checklist (short):
- BGP up + advertise /28 service block
- NAT for outbound artifact fetch during bootstrap
- Firewall: allow 22, 443, 123, 5000-5010
- MTU 9000 end-to-end

raj: Ops handoff steps:
1) Run node bootstrap script (link: https://confluence.company.internal/edge-bootstrap)
2) Validate kubelet + device plugin
3) Run canary job (gpu-smoke-test)
4) Confirm console dashboards show per-token latency within SLO

kevin: on-call for handoff window is @kevin (ops). I'll be on-call during maintenance.

deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled: 2026-03-05 02:00 UTC -> 2026-03-05 05:00 UTC. Runbook link: https://runbooks.company.internal/acme-eu-west-3

maria: final ask to security: please approve KMS cross-account policy by EOD. Without it we can't bind keys.

security: Approved with caveats: key usage restricted to 'decrypt' for seed service account only. Need IAM role audit.

maria: thanks. last thing: post-handoff cost note — monitor GPU utilization for 72h, autoscale min=2 max=24 to control spend. I'll post a follow-up summary after cutover. :rocket: 

customer-oncall: we confirm ASNs and will provide BGP translations by 18:00 UTC today.

maria: perfect, locking this thread as single source of truth. Will update with final go/no-go 1h before window.
